scope: Optional single-sequence throughput inference: FP16 paged attention, complete page-scoped decoder recording, and generation adapters
hardware: Apple M4 Max, native Metal, Mac OS X aarch64

model_acceptance.fp16_gate_declared_before_execution: 0.03 + 0.003 * abs(reference), plus exact greedy token IDs and text
model_acceptance.additional_real_model_boundary_check: 31-token prefill and four decodes: bit-identical ordinary/recorded paged outputs, 35 committed tokens, two recordings

original_fp32_control.acceptance: Unchanged 0.003 + 0.0003 * abs(reference), exact token/text continuations and transfer guards pass

native_checks: FP32 and independent tiny checkpoint agreement; ordinary and recorded paged parity
40 successive decodes to capacity 70, rebuilding at two page boundaries
Previously returned logits remain unchanged across replay and page changes
Device generation repeats with fresh cache ownership and identical tokens
Policy, mask, batch, chunk, capacity and stale-weight rejection before mutation
Ordinary Backend.execute sees only the two device copies on a repeated decode
Deferred error snapshots preserve an early report through later resets
Out-of-range device token fails before logical cache commit
Injected recording scratch, position and report allocation failures release resources
Kernel-debug execution, chunked causality and context-owned resource cleanup
boundaries: FP16 cache/attention is an explicit throughput-only inference policy; default and exact sessions remain FP32
Batch one, causal attention without an additional mask, even head dimensions through 256, supported device group memory
Recorded decode accepts exactly one token; prefill and ordinary paged append accept multiple tokens
Pools allocate rounded session capacity up front; logical page reservations grow as needed
GPU input/output copies, host position/length metadata updates, error readbacks and sampling stay outside the recording
No custom shaders, numerical host fallback, dependency upgrades or float atomic accumulation introduced
FP16 gate is checkpoint-specific acceptance, not a general mathematical model-error guarantee
No controlled throughput improvement or measured GPU peak-memory claim
Vulkan, long contexts, shared pools, prefix sharing, fork/truncate, batching and scheduling remain unverified or unimplemented
GPU training and generalized mixed-precision or quantized execution remain separate gates
